name: NSW Ambulance fee exemption for Health Care Card holders
summary: Health Care Card holders are exempt from NSW Ambulance fees; claim the exemption against your invoice.
who: The patient must hold a valid Health Care Card or Pensioner Concession Card
how: On Service NSW, select 'Manage your invoice', enter your payment reference number and issue date, and provide your exemption details
catches: Partners or family members listed on the card are not exempt.

source.label: NSW Ambulance: Exemptions from NSW Ambulance fees

evidence.quote: Some ambulance services are provided free of charge to people who hold a valid concession card
The patient must have a valid health care card and/or pensioner concession card to be exempt from the fee.
